object.description: Give an object of the open document a figure and run Export with draw.io desktop missing, the figure left undrawn; run Export with each figure drawn; run Export on a document without figures. Expected: the first export shows one notice of figures not drawn, naming the object and saying that the figure program couldn't be found; the other two exports show no notice.
